text: Lexington is down March 16 through March 18. Also the airbag module order to San Antonio is rescheduled from March 15 to March 19.
why: The extra-item split requires 'Also,' with a comma. 'Also' with no comma leaves one section, and the outage consumes it so the delay is dropped.

text: Lexington is down March 16 through March 18; the airbag module delivery to San Antonio has been moved from March 15 to March 18.
why: A semicolon between a full outage and a full 'delivery has been moved' delay is not a splitter. Outage wins and the delay is dropped.
